user.title: Add Tuya Cloudless device
user.description: Enter your Tuya WiFi device details. No cloud account required. The local key is obtained during initial pairing via the Web Bluetooth pairing page.

data_description.gw_id: Tuya device ID, shown during BLE pairing (e.g. abc123def456)
data_description.local_key: 16-character local key from pairing (kept secret on your HA instance)
data_description.ip_address: Device IP address (assign a static DHCP lease for reliability)
data_description.protocol_version: Version 3.3 works for most devices from 2020 onwards
data_description.device_type: Select the closest match — affects which entities are created

discovery.title: Discovered Tuya device
discovery.description:
A Tuya device was found at **{ip_address}** (protocol v{version}).

Enter the local key to complete setup.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to device — check IP address and that the device is on the same network
error.invalid_local_key: Invalid local key — must be exactly 16 characters
error.invalid_gw_id: Invalid device ID — must not be empty
error.auth_failed: Authentication failed — local key may be incorrect or device was re-paired to Tuya cloud
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check Home Assistant logs for details

abort.not_tuya_device: Device did not respond as a Tuya device

data_description.ip_address: Update if the device IP changed
data_description.protocol_version: Change only if the device stopped responding
